points.description: Correct symbolic linearised state-space form with states x=[δθ, δθ̇]: A = [[0,1],[−mgℓ cosθe/J, −b/J]] and B = [[0],[1/J]]. Must use cos θe (derivative of sin θ) with the correct negative sign on A21 and −b/J in A22. Using sin θe, a sign error on A21, or other wrong symbolic form earns no marks.

Correct numerical entries: A = [[0,1],[−61.3,−2.5]] (A21 ≈ −61.3 from 1×9.81×0.25×0.5/0.02), and B = [[0],[50]]. Accept g=9.81 (−61.3) or small rounding differences. Award if numbers are consistent with the student's own symbolic expression only where the error is not in B (e.g. an own-expression A21 with correct −2.5 and 50); B=[0,1]^T (forgot 1/J) loses this mark.

rubric.notes: P1 is for the correct symbolic A and B (cos θe, correct signs). P2 is for the numerical entries −61.3, −2.5, 50. Using sin θe or measuring from the horizontal (A21 = −106.2) loses P1; the numerical mark may be given only if the numbers follow from the student's own expression and B is correct. Maximum 1 for any single common error.
